Dirty tables, absent hygiene
Mar 2020
I've eaten at this place many times in the past and the food and prices are great - that's not the problem. The problem is during these coronavirus times, to go there and see tables that have been barely cleaned, staff not wearing gloves or masks, a filthy kitchen (from what we could see of it when we paid the bill), and a big table of "20-something" Euro expats laughing about how their friends are all in quarantine and that they would get the virus and didn't care - which, unfortunately, seems to be pretty normal with the folks who frequent this place.

It felt unsafe and we will not be returning.

Walked in but should have walked straight back out again.
Jun 2019 • Couples
It was my wife's birthday treat, we had travelled for well over an hour and we were both starving!
This place is a shack - metal poles supporting a clear, plastic corrugated roof. The man-hole cover for the drain (situated in the eating area) is not sealed so the smell of sewerage combined with the heat becomes unbearable.
Most of the crockery is chipped and dirty - ALL of the crockery needs cleaning properly. The "sips' from previous customers are still stained on the cups.
The tables are wiped clean with a dirty cloth so food and grease is smeared across the surfaces.
We ordered identical meals - full English breakfast with extra bacon and tea. The plates arrived 5 minutes apart - one without the extra bacon and one without tea.
The stainless steel teapots contain far too much water for a single teabag so only pathetic weak tea is possible.
Their "cider" is probably the most disgusting liquid I have ever tasted in my entire life - I'm not exaggerating! I have never tasted anything more repulsive. Clearly home-made it tastes only of cheap yeast and tree bark - indeed the ice cubes they add without permission probably improves the flavour. Absolutely vile! Totally undrinkable and most repulsive!
I complained but only received a smirk - no explanation, no apology and certainly no refund! Totally unacceptable!
To be fair the food was actually cooked quite well (aside from the ever-overwhelming burned oil flavour) and it is a shame that poor hygiene and appalling customer service defeated any reason to visit again.

Great Food
Sep 2017 • Solo
Great place with welcoming staff and friendly patrons. End up spending time wrapped up in great conversation with everyone there. The food is on point! I never thought it would be difficult to find a place with a "western breakfast". Little did I know eggs, sausage, bacon and such is not standard morning food here in Vietnam. Home38 offers a full english breakfast that is to die for. As for dinner, make sure you have one of their delicious burgers. Many different kinds to choose from and the size is large. Make sure to wash it down with their homemade cider. Fixes well with a juicy burger. Definitely one of my favorite places to eat.
